senses.gloss:
m. (-कः)
A tree: see the next.

m. (-शः)
A tree, (Dalbergia ougeiniensis.)
E.
अति exceeding, निश to meditate, affix क and the initial of the prefix rejected, deriv. irr.

mf. (-डः-डी)
The tamarind tree, (Tamarindus Indica.)
m. (-डः)
1 The name of a demon.
2 Acid seasoning, sour sauce.
3 An inauspicious period, the evil aspect of planets, &c.
f. (-डी)
Emblic myrobalan.
E.
तिम to be damp or moist, अच् affix, the root reduplicated, and ड substituted for the final म.

f. (-का)
The tamarind tree.
E.
कन् added to तिन्तिडी.

subst. mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
The tamarind tree.
n. (-कं)
1 Acid seasoning.
2 The fruit of the tamarind.
E.
तिन्तिड as above, and ईकन् Uṇādi aff.

n. (-तं)
A kind of game, a sort of odd or even played with tamarind seeds.
E.
तिन्तिडी the tamarind, and द्यूत playing.

f. (-ली)
The tamarind tree.
E.
see तिन्तिड, ल being substituted for ड; also कन् being added in the usual form, तिन्तिलिका, or retaining the final तिन्तिलीका.

m. (-न्दुः)
A species of ebony, from the fruit of which a kind of resin is obtained, that is used in India as pitch for caulking vessels, &c. (Diospyros glutinosa.)
E.
तिम to be wet or moist, affix कु; also with कन् added, तिन्दुक.

mf. (-कः-की)
A sort of ebony, (Diospyros glutinosa.)
f. (-की)
The resinous fruit of this tree: see the preceding. Also with इ substituted for the final तिन्दुकि.
n. (-कं)
A Karṣa, the measure.
E.
तिन्दु, and कन् added.

m. (-लः)
A sort of ebony: see the preceding.
E.
लच् added to तिन्दु.
